variable_coverage.construction: ACCURACY: Negative absolute value of the I/B/E/S analysts’ mean annual earnings forecast minus actual I/B/E/S earnings, divided by the stock price at the end of the prior fiscal year. Higher values indicate more accurate forecasts. Formula: −|mean I/B/E/S annual EPS forecast − actual I/B/E/S EPS| / prior fiscal-year-end stock price. Raw inputs and limitations are recorded in the linked requirements.

SUE: Absolute unexpected earnings scaled by the stock price at the end of the prior year; unexpected earnings equals actual earnings less the mean analyst forecast. Formula: |actual earnings − mean analyst forecast| / prior-year-end stock price. Raw inputs and limitations are recorded in the linked requirements.

BIAS: Signed forecast error scaled by stock price at the end of the prior fiscal year; forecast error equals the I/B/E/S mean annual analyst forecast less actual I/B/E/S earnings. Formula: (mean I/B/E/S annual EPS forecast − actual I/B/E/S EPS) / prior fiscal-year-end stock price. Raw inputs and limitations are recorded in the linked requirements.

SMTH1: Negative of the ratio of the rolling standard deviation of income before extraordinary items scaled by average total assets to the rolling standard deviation of cash flow from operations scaled by average total assets; rolling calculation requires at least three and at most five years. Cash flow from operations equals income before extraordinary items minus accruals; accruals equal change in current assets minus change in current liabilities minus change in cash plus change in current debt in current liabilities minus depreciation and amortization. Larger values (closer to zero) indicate smoother earnings. Formula: − SD(NI before extraordinary items / average total assets) / SD(CFO / average total assets). Raw inputs and limitations are recorded in the linked requirements.
LNASSETS: Log of total assets measured in millions of U.S. dollars. Formula: ln(total assets in USD millions). Raw inputs and limitations are recorded in the linked requirements.
LEV: Total debt divided by total assets. Formula: total debt / total assets. Raw inputs and limitations are recorded in the linked requirements.
BM: Ratio of book value to market value of equity. Formula: book value of equity / market value of equity. Raw inputs and limitations are recorded in the linked requirements.

STD_SALES: Standard deviation of sales, used to capture volatility in the firm’s operating environment. The paper does not state its scaling or calculation window. Formula: standard deviation of sales. Raw inputs and limitations are recorded in the linked requirements.

%LOSS: Proportion of years in which the firm experiences losses over the last three to five years. Formula: loss years / years in the 3–5-year history. Raw inputs and limitations are recorded in the linked requirements.
OPCYCLE: Log of days of accounts receivable plus inventories. Formula: ln(days accounts receivable + inventory days). Raw inputs and limitations are recorded in the linked requirements.
SG: Average sales growth over the past three to five years. Formula: average sales growth over prior 3–5 years. Raw inputs and limitations are recorded in the linked requirements.
OPLEV: Net property, plant, and equipment divided by total assets. Formula: net PP&E / total assets. Raw inputs and limitations are recorded in the linked requirements.

AVECFO: Average cash flow from operations divided by total assets, measured over the last five years. Formula: average(CFO / total assets) over past 5 years. Raw inputs and limitations are recorded in the linked requirements.

SMTH2: Negative of the level correlation between cash flow from operations and total accruals. Table 2 says both inputs are scaled by average total assets, whereas Appendix A says total assets; the denominator wording conflicts. It is calculated over rolling windows requiring at least three and at most five years, and larger values (closer to one) indicate smoother earnings. The source does not specify an exact formula. ILLIQ: Combined illiquidity measure: average of the scaled percentile ranks of available ZERORET and LN(BIDASK); if BIDASK is unavailable, use the percentile rank of ZERORET. ZERORET is the percent of fiscal-year trading days with no price change. BIDASK is the fiscal-year median relative bid–ask spread, (ASK−BID)/((ASK+BID)/2), and LN(BIDASK) is the transformed component. The reference population and scaling convention for “scaled percentile rank” are not reported. Formula: average(scaled_percentile_rank(ZERORET), scaled_percentile_rank(ln(BIDASK))) when BIDASK available; scaled_percentile_rank(ZERORET) otherwise. Raw inputs and limitations are recorded in the linked requirements.

LNMVE: Natural logarithm of market value of equity at fiscal year-end, with MVE measured in U.S. dollars (millions). Formula: ln(MVE). Raw inputs and limitations are recorded in the linked requirements.
BM: Book value of common equity divided by market value of equity. Formula: book value of common equity / market value of equity. Raw inputs and limitations are recorded in the linked requirements.

LOSS: Indicator equal to 1 if net income before extraordinary items is negative, and 0 otherwise. Formula: 1(NI before extraordinary items < 0). Raw inputs and limitations are recorded in the linked requirements.
STDRET: Annual standard deviation of monthly stock returns. Formula: annual SD(monthly stock returns). Raw inputs and limitations are recorded in the linked requirements.

ADR EX: Indicator equal to 1 if the firm trades on a U.S. exchange during the year, and 0 otherwise. Formula: 1(trades on a U.S. exchange during year). Raw inputs and limitations are recorded in the linked requirements.
